description: This file serves as a header declaration for the lu5 core module, defining functions for initializing, running, updating, and closing the lu5 runtime, along with including necessary dependencies.

methods.name: lu5_get_handle
methods.description: Returns a handle to the current lu5 runtime state.

methods.name: lu5_init
methods.description: Initializes the lu5 runtime with the specified state.

methods.name: lu5_run_sketch
methods.description: Runs a sketch located at the given filename with the provided source code within the specified lu5 state.

methods.name: lu5_animation_frame
methods.description: Advances the animation frame by the specified delta time.

methods.name: lu5_close
methods.description: Closes and cleans up the lu5 runtime associated with the specified state.
